name: cache-clock
description: A mod that shows when the prompt cache likely expires (`cache warm → ~14:32`) under the prompt, turning to a cold warning past a configured TTL. Approximate: last main-loop turn plus the TTL.

enabled.title: Enable the mod
enabled.description: Off removes the cache warm and cold line under the prompt. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session. Only an exact false turns it off.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache is assumed to live after the last main-loop turn: 5m (the API default, used by API-key sessions) or 1h (Claude Code's main-conversation cache on a Claude subscription, or with ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H).

display.title: Where to show it
display.description: hint stacks a coloured segment under the prompt hint; status pins a plain status line under the prompt.
